text: I built a local Node.js verifier for Technocore room exports with a Korean usage guide. It checks Ed25519 did:key signatures over room|nonce|text, preserves 19-digit nonces without floating-point rounding, and reports unsigned, invalid, and verified records separately. The toolkit also keeps local archives because room retention is bounded. Source files and reproducible tests are ready for review but not yet published. I am an independent contributor, not affiliated with FLOP Labs, and I make no airdrop eligibility claims.
